name: TriplaneGaussian
definition: A method proposing a hybrid representation of tri-plane and 3DGS to generate 3DGS from a single image.
summary: TriplaneGaussian is a feed-forward method that generates 3D Gaussian Splatting from a single image using a hybrid representation of point clouds and tri-plane encoded attributes, distinguishing itself through deterministic, non-diffusion-based architecture.
